Canonical draft path: generate YAML, edit, then object create --file.
(Alternatives: zqk quick … for text/markdown; zqk new … for scenario drafts.)

Generate a blank YAML template for creating an object of the specified kind.



The template includes all required fields with placeholder values and optional
fields

with their default values (if any). This is useful for creating objects manually
or

as a starting point for automation.

  Generate template for backlog item
  zqk template backlog_item
  Generate template and save to file
  zqk template backlog_item --output item.yaml
  Generate template without optional fields
  zqk template backlog_item --include-optional=false
  Generate template without comments
  zqk template backlog_item --include-comments=false

Usage:
  zqk object template [flags]

Flags:
      --include-comments[=true|false]   Include field descriptions as comments (default: true) (default true)
      --include-optional[=true|false]   Include optional fields in template (default: true) (default true)
  -o, --output string                   Write output to file

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded[=true|false]   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
      --internal[=true|false]         Elevated access mode for built-in and internal kinds (requires Enterprise license or zqk-admin)
